messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: multiple runtimes reporting slow resident growth and paged-attn allocation fragmentation -> increased OOM risk. Signals: rising resident_bytes, eviction failing. Affected pool: eu-west-1/gpu-general.
anya: saw this spike ~03:12 UTC, node node-gpu-12a started returning CUDA error logs.
morgan: yep, stack: `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` then container restart `runt-4f2b` on that node. grabbing logs. :eyes:
raj: impact check: ~0.8% request error rate across hosted API for a small subset of tenants, latency P95 up 120ms. biggest noisy tenant: acme-marketing.
anya: logs: `oom_kill_process: pid=4821 comm=python` then `nvml: BAR1 allocation failed` and repeated `kv_cache: page_fragmentation > 0.78`.
lex: looks like paged-attn allocator leaking page metadata; compaction not keeping up with allocation churn for long sequences. fragmentation ratio trending upward over 6+ hours.
morgan: mitigation idea: reduce max_batch_tokens and bump kv eviction aggressiveness on the affected pool, then failover noisy customers to smaller quantized model variant.
anya: rolling a quick mitigation now: `redwoodctl node set --node node-gpu-12a --kv-evict-threshold 0.55` and `redwoodctl pool update --pool eu-west-1/gpu-general --max_batch_tokens 1024`. posting commands so oncall can repro.
raj: please also enable fallback route for acme-marketing: route -> `rw/gpt-medium-q4f16` with lower token cap.
customer-ops: acme-marketing ops notified via status page and we added note: "intermittent 5xxs, investigating".
incident-bot: On-call handoff created: @morgan -> @anya for live mitigation. Pager duty incident ID: PD-8421.
morgan: after changes, node-gpu-12a resident growth slowed but one other node (node-gpu-09c) shows similar creeping pattern. triggering cluster-wide compaction: `POST /admin/kv/compact_all?pool=eu-west-1`
lex: compaction kicked off, but compaction throughput is low when kernels are hot. we should also temporarily reduce concurrency on affected pool: `redwoodctl pool update --pool eu-west-1/gpu-general --max_concurrency 6`.
anya: customers failing now limited to 0.2%, routing fallbacks in place for the top 3 noisy tenants. system metrics: fragmentation ratio peaked 0.82, now 0.64. CUDA errors stopped on node-gpu-12a, container restarts reduced.
raj: capturing short RCA items for next steps: 1) enable diagnostic memory profiling on two nodes (12a, 09c) 2) add deterministic KV-page compaction trigger on fragmentation > 0.7 3) add unit test to simulate long-seq churn and measure compaction latency 4) triage allocator codepath for metadata leak.
morgan: created follow-up ticket INF-1429 with traces and container IDs. attaching kernel logs and nvml dumps.
lex: also recommend we add a temporary alert rule to SLOs: if fragmentation > 0.7 for > 30m then auto-reduce max_batch_tokens and trigger compaction.
customer-ops: update sent: ACME ops acknowledged, will monitor. they reported a few failed requests while fallbacks applied but accepted temporary degrade.
anya: handoff summary for next oncall: mitigations applied (evict threshold lowered, compaction run, concurrency reduced, routing fallbacks). Current status: stabilizing, fragmentation trending down, minor customer impact still under watch. Next steps: run memory profiler, collect heap/dump, and plan a patch to compaction heuristics.
morgan: adding timestamped artifacts to the incident: s3://redwood-incidents/INF-1429/6543219999/ (nvml, kernel, profiler).
incident-bot: Incident annotated as "stabilized" at 6543220567. Please keep thread updated with any regressions. :thumbsup:
